questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: At Vrije University I had the possibility of choosing curses that were not available to my at UCPH. I also had the opportunity to broaden my academic perspective as I had curses that were very different from the curses I have taking at UCPH.

questions.answer: very easy

questions.answer: I had a shared kitchen with 12 people.

Additional comments:

questions.answer: very easy to figure out and apply for curses.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Student counsellors specific for exchange student

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: very succesful! I got all the classes that I applied for.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: don't stress

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: I had both MA and BA courses.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: very different! Many classes where mandatory and there were assignemtns during the period. Furthermore, the semester was divided in to 3 periods which meant that there were 3 exam periods. For me it felt like being back in the gymnasium.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Knowing by sensing, health communication and social media, diversity 1 and 2, sex work and anti trafficking.

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
sex work and anti trafficking and Knowing by sensing. 
Both courses were very interesting and very different!

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Get housing through the University
Check exam dates and exam form before registrering for courses
expect to spend a lot of time studying
